up: Return a list of distinct compounds (ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES) that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4303122'. Include only compounds that have an associated record in this document.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4303122';
